Futebol Clube Paços de Ferreira is a Portuguese professional football club based in Paços de Ferreira, Porto District. Founded in 1950, the club competes in Liga 3, holding home games at the 9,076 seat Estádio Capital do Móvel The club's colours are yellow and green. The club is owned 100% by its members (\"sócios\").
